policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="availableFilteredModels" value="@{
            var models = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("config-models");
            if (models == null) {
                return "[]";
            }

            // Get allowedModels filter from product policy
            var allowedModelsStr = context.Variables.ContainsKey("allowedModels")
                ? (string)context.Variables["allowedModels"]
                : "";

            HashSet allowedSet = null;
            if (!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(allowedModelsStr)) {
                allowedSet = new HashSet(
                    allowedModelsStr.Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                                    .Select(m => m.Trim()),
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase
                );
            }

            var deployments = new JArray();
            var seenNames = new HashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            foreach (var prop in models.Properties()) {
                var modelName = prop.Name;

                // Skip duplicates
                if (seenNames.Contains(modelName)) continue;
                seenNames.Add(modelName);

                // Apply allowedModels filter
                if (allowedSet != null && !allowedSet.Contains(modelName)) continue;

                var modelConfig = (JObject)prop.Value;
                var backend = modelConfig["backend"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                var poolType = modelConfig["pool-type"]?.ToString() ?? "azure-openai";
                var sku = modelConfig["sku"]?.ToString() ?? "Standard";
                var capacity = modelConfig["capacity"]?.ToString() ?? "100";
                var modelFormat = modelConfig["modelFormat"]?.ToString() ?? "OpenAI";
                var modelVersion = modelConfig["modelVersion"]?.ToString() ?? "1";
                var retirementDate = modelConfig["retirementDate"]?.ToString();

                var deployment = new JObject()
                {
                    { "id", backend },
                    { "type", poolType },
                    { "name", modelName },
                    { "sku", new JObject() { { "name", sku }, { "capacity", Int32.Parse(capacity) } } },
                    { "properties", new JObject() {
                        { "model", new JObject() { { "format", modelFormat }, { "name", modelName }, { "version", modelVersion } } },
                        { "capabilities", new JObject() { { "chatCompletion", "true" } } },
                        { "provisioningState", "Succeeded" }
                    }}
                };

                if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(retirementDate)) {
                    ((JObject)deployment["properties"])["retirementDate"] = retirementDate;
                }

                deployments.Add(deployment);
            }

            return deployments.ToString();
        }" />

        
        
            
            
                application/json
            
            @{
                JObject response = new JObject();
                response["value"] = JArray.Parse((string)context.Variables["availableFilteredModels"]);
                return response.ToString();
            }
